name: What types of custom glass installations does Hometelligent Inc. offer?

mainEntity.name: What types of custom glass installations does Hometelligent Inc. offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent Inc. provides a range of custom glass installation services including frameless shower enclosures, custom mirrors, glass tabletops, glass railings, and specialty architectural glass. The type of glass installation best suited for your project often depends on the specific function and aesthetic you aim to achieve, whether it's for a modern bathroom upgrade or a unique commercial space in the Alameda or Berkeley areas. We work with clients to determine the optimal glass type and design for their needs.
